positioning.description: Host positioning model — see TankPositioning for details. Defaults to button (host fills parent container, 100% × 100%, falling back to the design aspect ratio on any axis the parent leaves indefinite, no anchor...

static.description: Static (display-only) variant. Always rendered at the compact size; the inner chart/bar is hidden, the bordered area is filled with --container-section-color, and the readout is centered inside the frame. Tag is...

activated.description: Enables the activated background color, used to indicate that the tank is activated/selected. Requires an interactive tank — the noClick mixin variant used when clickable is false only paints the enabled state, so a...

chartMode.description: Chart cell rendering mode. - bar: static fill bar driven by value/max (default). - graph: embedded obc-gauge-trend line/area chart. - graphAndBar: embedded obc-gauge-trend with an integrated side bar.

priority.description: Priority hint forwarded to child charts (regular | enhanced).

hasAdvice.description: Show advice overlays (works in all chartMode variants).

alert.description: Show an <obc-alert-frame> overlay around the bordered tank area (the .halo wrapper). Mirrors the API of obc-automation-button: same six properties, same three slots (alert-icon, alert-label, alert-timer). The ring...

percentFractionDigits.description: Number of fraction digits used to format the percent readout in the non-compact (regular) layout. Defaults to 0 (integer percent). The compact layout always renders integer percent to keep its fixed-width footprint...

badgeControl.description: Enum-driven badges rendered inside the badges cell. Mirrors the API introduced for ObcAbstractAutomationButton in PR #839 (#829). When set to a non-None value, an <obc-automation-badge> of the corresponding type is...

setpoint.description: Target setpoint value. undefined = no setpoint marker shown.

newSetpoint.description: Adjustment preview for 2-step interface. When defined, two markers are shown: original (dimmed) + new (focus). Available when setpoint!=undefined.

autoAtSetpointDeadband.description: Tolerance for auto at-setpoint detection. Available when setpoint!=undefined && autoAtSetpoint==true.

setpointAtZeroDeadband.description: Tolerance for zero-snap visual state. Available when setpoint!=undefined.

setpointOverride.description: Override to derive the setpoint color from the instrument's priority regardless of instrument state. Available when setpoint!=undefined.

animateSetpoint.description: Enable CSS-animated confirm transition. Available when setpoint!=undefined.

unit.description: The unit printed after the capacity, in place of the cubic metres of the pinned package's tank.

hasCapacity.description: Whether a static tank prints its capacity. False draws the vessel and its tag with no capacity line, where the pinned package's tank always prints one.

componentSize.description: Component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
